functions.name: cancel-meeting
functions.description: Cancel a scheduled meeting before it has started, rather than deleting its record.

functions.name: delete-group

Other groups lose access references to this group. General cannot be deleted. Use `remove-group-member` instead to remove only one membership.

functions.name: delete-recording

FunctionInput_demodesk_deleterecording.description: Recording to permanently delete by its public token.

FunctionOutput_demodesk_deleterecording.description: Acknowledgment of recording deletion and scheduled media and transcript erasure.

Scorecards remain unlinked. Deleting the last recording of a manually uploaded meeting also removes that meeting. Success means the row is gone and erasure is scheduled, not completed. Requires the host, a company admin, or an authorized manager.

functions.name: delete-user
